case_name: Federation Of All India Customs And Centralexcisestenographers v Union Of India And Ors.
petitioner: Federation Of All India Customs And Centralexcisestenographers
holding: The differentiation has been sought to be justified in view of the nature and the types of the work done, that is, on intelligible basis. The same amount of physical work may entail different quality of work, some more sensitive, some requiring more tact, some less--it varies from nature and culture of employment.
